text:
Maya: Quick note  I'm assembling a compact "manager orientation cheatsheet" to include in offer packs. Focus: actions to reduce admin friction in week 1.
Owen: Good idea. Please add a short who-to-contact table (IT, Security, Facilities, Legal) with example phrasing they can copy.
Liu: Include a tiny 30/60/90 template and three example goals for eng infra, product, and platform managers.
Tara: Security checklist: MFA, disk encryption, KMS access request, runbook access. Prioritize as MUST / ASAP / NICE-TO-HAVE.
Maya: Draft below  trying to keep scheduled meetings under 4 hours total week 1. Edits welcome.
Maya: Pre-start (3 business days before): create Okta + infra tickets, confirm laptop shipment/tracking, assign onboarding buddy, badge request for office starts. Short copy: "Please open Okta/infrastructure access tickets 3 business days before start (example: ROLE: backend-manager)."
OnboardBot: Badge request submitted. ETA 2 business days.
Owen: Day 1 (half day): 30m People Ops welcome, 20m HR admin/payroll, 30m team meet & greet, 15m systems access walkthrough (Okta, Console links + runbook pointer).
Liu: Day 2: 45m Product context & roadmap, 30m Security intro, 30m buddy shadow / team rituals. Add a 15m "how we escalate incidents" walkthrough.
Tara: Day 3: 45m 30/60/90 planning workshop (manager-only), 30m 1:1 kickoff template with direct reports, copyable 1:1 snippet: "Wins / Blockers / Priorities / Support Needed".
Maya: Day 4: Ops & monitoring primer (60m)  Redwood Console, SLAs, alerting playbook. Day 5: Stakeholder intros + end-of-week check-in (30m).
Owen: Calendar bundle (paste into invite):
- Day 1 09:30 - PeopleOps Welcome & Admin (50m)
- Day 1 11:00 - Team Meet & Greet (30m)
- Day 2 10:00 - Product + Roadmap (45m)
- Day 2 14:00 - Security Intro (30m)
- Day 3 10:00 - 30/60/90 Planning (45m)
- Day 4 09:30 - Infra & Monitoring Primer (60m)
- Day 5 15:00 - Stakeholder Intro & Week Recap (30m)
Maya: 30/60/90 starter (copyable):
- 30d: Build cross-functional relationships, confirm team access, ship a small process improvement.
- 60d: Take ownership of a prioritized backlog item, establish weekly planning cadence, collect first feedback.
- 90d: Implement one measurable operational change, set draft OKRs, present progress to stakeholders.
Liu: Example goals by manager type (short):
- Eng infra: reduce CI median time by 15% (30d), automate one deployment step (60d), codify runbook for common failures (90d).
- Product: validate top customer problem via 3 interviews (30d), ship quick experiment (60d), define success metric & roadmap slice (90d).
- Platform: document onboarding playbook for new services (30d), retire two legacy alarms (60d), publish capacity plan (90d).
Tara: Compliance flag: "If role touches regulated data, schedule Legal+Security intake in week 1."
Maya: Quick copy-paste who-to-ask lines:
- IT: "Hi IT — please provision Okta group ROLE-X and laptop. New manager: NAME, start DATE."
- Security: "Hi Security — request KMS, runbook access, and incident pager for ROLE-X."
- Facilities: "Badge access for NAME on START_DATE to BUILDING."
- Legal: "Please attach NDAs and scope any customer-sensitive Docs for NAME."
Owen: Suggest a 5-question end-of-week survey for first-week feedback (access issues, missing docs, unclear owners, meeting overload, onboarding pace). If 'access issues' checked, tag IT.
Liu: Add note for hiring manager: create tech access tickets 3 working days before start to avoid delays. Also recommend a pre-start check call with buddy 1 day prior.
Maya: I'll turn this into a one-page PDF + Google Calendar template and drop link here. Can folks review by Wednesday?
Owen: I can review tomorrow.
Tara: Friday works for me.
Maya: Thanks! Will post final link and add to People Ops playbooks. :sparkles:
